verdict.rationale: LegalOS presents end-to-end petition execution as its core service. It says it will "build and file your EB-1A/EB-2 NIW case end to end" through petition preparation, attorney review and USCIS filing, and keeps preparation, review and filing within one team. For O-1 it describes criteria-mapped evidence, organized recommendation materials and an attorney-reviewed petition package. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that LegalOS drafts expert and support letters (it only says recommendation materials are "organized"), any explicit mention of preparing the USCIS forms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these vendor claims.
